result.summary: Page structure is intact but 'Fastest near you' looks visually broken due to duplicate Green Bowl Poké cards side-by-side and a mid-word truncated title, plus low-contrast delivery fee text.

issues.description: First two cards under 'Fastest near you' are identical - same image, same '15-25 min' badge, same name 'Green Bowl Poké' and same '€0.90 delivery' text side-by-side
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant feed so the carousel shows unique venues; verify API / list logic is not returning the same item twice

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated title 'Smash Bros Bu' cut off mid-word at screen edge without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards use proper truncation with ellipsis and sufficient peeking padding so partial titles do not look broken

issues.description: Secondary info text like '€0.90 delivery' and '€2.40 delivery' uses very light gray on white with small font size, low contrast
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text color to meet WCAG contrast minimums while keeping visual hierarchy
